value.rationale: The exact minimal-fort hypergraph and entire zero-forcing polynomial of a natural edge-deleted complete bipartite family identify how deletion creates four-vertex minimal forts and decreases zero-forcing number by two versus the intact case. It is a complete natural all-parameter classification useful for fort-cover counting, not a routine numerical substitution.
